Ivys can unlock powerful temporal fragments in his mind, accessing historical events, myths, legends, and even events from the future. Here are some of them broken down.


## **The Faces**: [MUSIC](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kArgjNWRo68)

You find yourself in a dark space, rocks piled in hills around you, the ground like sand shifts beneath your feet. You watch as golden glowing jellyfish float leisurely trough the think heavy air. You see the body of a creature, 4 arms, strange outer skin like a shell, almost humanoid, but larger. It has some kind of circlet, a head piece.. a crown, broken, it lies cold, dead, unresponsive to your touch.
As you study it closely, a scorpion crawls from its cloak, and then another, thousands of them scattering from the carcass as it experiences a thousand years of decay in a mere moment before you. As you stand, recoiling in horror at what you have witnessed. 

You see the sand begin to sink in front of you, a rift in the stone beneath widens into a chasm as you stumble backwards, fighting against the grains as they pull you down. Eventually you are taken by the flow of the sands, falling into the lightless pit, where you see the face. 
In glowing blue crystals, as if they fall with you, on the opposite side of the chasm you see Kairos, his faces, Horus, Karius, Abagnale, Bekarys, and hundreds of others you do not recognize.
You fall as they stare blankly, and spin. Behind you there is nothing but darkness, until a single glowing blue crystal rises to your level, you freeze, halting your freefall, and are met with just two faces, yours, and that of a woman.

You shoot upwards as you awaken, a cold sweat, and a strange sense of Deja vu.


## **The Uncrowned**: MUSIC

As you dream, you reach out again to that strange unknown region of your mind, the one that may not be just yours... and you find something.

You see red, hatred, rage, blood pouring down your brow as you lash out with your weapon, your cruel red blade slashes through one, two, three forms before you blink.
As you raise your eyes from the dirt, the violent pinging returns, the urge, the desire, the NEED! KILL KILL KILL AND KILL AGAIN, UNTIL NOTHING REMAINS, BRING MORE TO THE SLAUGHTER! FEED ME THEIR SOULS!
You lick the blood from your lips, your open eyes comprehending the trail of carnage behind you, you hate it, and you love it. A woman in black, feathered wings, stitches across her brow, her pale grey skin familiar to you, Zyrathia. 
She holds in he arms a body, "Their commander my King, you must eat."
You feel an ancient, terrible hunger, it has been months that you have denied yourself, you have not feasted since you were revived. You despise the nature of it, but regular food will no longer satiate you. Your entire body lunges forward, your jaw ripping your skin as it opens and your fangs lengthen, you pause for just a moment at the apex of your action, a hesitation. Will you feed?

**ACCEPT**: You allow your body to indulge, you gore upon the flesh of the commander, tearing away his garments and armor as your ravage his form. You feel your body pulse with strength, the Reckoner grows as you regain your strength, and he is still hungry. 
As you feed, you leap to the next body, devouring them by the tens as you grow larger, desecrating the bodies of your enemies, you feel yourself leave the form of this being, and rise into the sky, seeing the mountains north of the village, the sea to the West, and a tall Purple Tower rising on an island beyond as the sun sets on this place.

**REFUSE**: You force your mouth shut, shoving Zyrathia away as she looks at you sadly. You sheath your sword, pulling your cloak over your head and turning away from the village you have slaughtered. You feel regret, a wish that you had not given in to the Reckoner's lust. You leave the form of this being, and rise into the sky, seeing the mountains north of the village, the sea to the West, and a tall Purple Tower rising on an island beyond as the sun sets on this place.

As you depart, trudging through the mud, no graves, no memories, ashes and blood. A man, a beast, a trunk, a creature you do not recognize walks beside you. "An excellent showing my King, and I think you will find I was correct that this was a suitable are for you to... let loose."


## **The Field**: MUSIC

You rise in a golden grass field, the tall reeds softly blowing in the wind. You look out over the beautiful scenery, aware of the inner peace you feel. Everything is safe, you are ok, and you always will be, because you have someone who protects you. You have love, love between two people that nothing could overshadow or overcome. You sip cool water from a canteen as you look around and see woodland creatures in the tree line, they bow to you as they continue towards the forest.
As you sit yourself up you see a figure beside you, though you cannot make out his features, its as if he has been erased... or you have.
He reaches out to you, his hands are suddenly cold and unfamiliar, you feel your skin begin to crawl as he gets closer, the grass shrivels and dies around him. You feel a cold cut open in your abdomen as you look down at your white scales. They are stained red with your blood, and you are free.
As you pass on from your body you feel the red return, the rage, the anger of the father, and you awaken, clutching a dagger in your hand, pointed at your own side. Blood drips down onto your legs from your nose.
